title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Candlelight flickers across tall shelves. You are locked inside an old library. You can see a desk, a bookshelf, a painting, a locked drawer and a door with a four-digit keypad.

desk.examine: A heavy oak desk. A torn note lies on it: 'The year this library was founded opens what is hidden.' A locked drawer is built into it.

bookshelf.examine: Four books are arranged differently from the rest. Handwritten on their spines, left to right, are the numbers 5, 2, 9, 3.

painting.examine: A stern portrait of the library's founder. The frame plate reads 'Founded 1847'. Something brass is taped to the back of the canvas: a small key.

drawer.examine_locked: The desk drawer has a small keyhole and a four-digit dial. It is locked.
drawer.examine_open: The drawer is open. It holds a folded paper.

door.examine: A heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad. It does not budge.

brass key.description: A small brass key with a worn bow.
brass key.take_message: You peel the brass key from the back of the painting and pocket it.

folded paper.description: A folded paper that reads: 'The way out is written on the books, in order.'
folded paper.take_message: You take the folded paper. It reads: 'The way out is written on the books, in order.'

hints.text: Have you looked closely at everything in the room, especially the walls?
Something on the painting might be useful. Try taking it.
The drawer has a keyhole. What do you carry that could fit?
The desk note speaks of a year. Where in the room is a year written?
Some books on the shelf are arranged oddly.
The paper says the way out is written on the books, in order.
